x.description: Numeric scatter x coordinate, otherwise null.

y.description: Numeric scatter y coordinate, otherwise null.

unit.description: Literal unit, including percent or thousand USD; do not rescale values.

notes.description: Uncertainty, coordinate units, or qualifications from the observations.

panel.description: Panel identifier from the observations, or positional identifier 1, 2, etc. Keep separate panels distinct.

value.description: Bar height, line value, slice value, heatmap cell, or box statistic. Null when missing; never reconstruct from expectations.

series.description: Legend series or box-plot group; null if absent.

reading.description: Printed only for an explicit numeric annotation. Estimated when read from geometry; unknown if absent or unclear.

category.description: Bar/line category, pie slice label, or heatmap column label.

row_label.description: Heatmap row label, or table row label.

statistic.description: Box statistic only. Whiskers are not assumed to be sample minima/maxima.

chart_type.description: Type described by the VLM, not necessarily the Docling classification.

measurements.description: One record per visible value, scatter point, or box statistic, across every panel. Exclude axis ticks and legend keys as measurements. Preserve missing values as null; do not invent hidden sample data.
